meta.siteTitle: MauAI — Your local-first AI library with visible sources
meta.siteDescription: MauAI is a local-first knowledge library in development. Add books and documents, ask naturally, and open the source behind the answer.
meta.ogTitle: MauAI — Your library. Alive, private, yours.
meta.ogDescription: A personal library that can search, explain, and show the source — on your own computer.

announcement: MauAI is in active development. Closed testing will begin after installation, Library, and citation flows are validated.

hero.eyebrow: A local-first library, guided by AI
hero.title: Your library. Alive, private, yours.
hero.body: MauAI is being built to search your books and documents, connect the ideas that matter, and show exactly where each answer came from — on your own computer, even offline after setup.
hero.note: In development for macOS and Windows. The 16 GB RAM target is still being validated.

positioning.title: Not another AI. A library that can speak.
positioning.body: Models change. Knowledge remains. In MAUAI, the library comes first. AI has a narrower, more useful job: search, organize, explain, and stop when the sources are not enough.
positioning.quote: You don't ask the AI what it remembers. You ask your library what it contains.

instrument.title: The library is the instrument. AI is the bow.
instrument.body: The library carries the knowledge. AI brings it into motion: it finds the right passage, connects it to other sources, and explains it in your language. Without a library, the model is only a storyteller. With sources, it becomes a navigator.

how.title: Ask naturally. Your library answers with the pages open.

steps.title: 1. Add books and documents
steps.body: The first version is designed for PDF, TXT, and Markdown. Documents are indexed locally with identity and provenance.

steps.title: 2. Ask in your own words
steps.body: No commands or acronyms to learn. Ask the way you would ask a careful librarian.

steps.title: 3. Open the source
steps.body: When an answer is library-backed, you see the document, passage, and page. MAUAI shows the path, not only the conclusion.

steps.title: 4. Search deeper when it is worth it
steps.body: If the first set of passages is not enough, you can request a deeper search. No model memory presented as evidence.

contract.title: A clear contract with the user

cards.label: Source-backed
cards.title: This is what the library says
cards.body: The answer includes the passages and pages it used. MAUAI aims to guarantee traceability to the source, not the absolute truth of the author.

cards.label: Not enough evidence
cards.title: The librarian stops
cards.body: When the documents do not support an answer, the system says so and can search deeper only with your consent.

cards.label: Free conversation
cards.title: No accuracy guarantee
cards.body: Responses generated without sources are clearly labelled and are never presented as information from your library.

my.title: My Library
my.body: Your books, notes, and documents. Private, user-controlled, and separate from the knowledge pack distributed with the product.

noah.title: Noah Library
noah.body: A curated, versioned, read-only knowledge pack built only from material that can be distributed legally. The first Noah Core Seed will be small and verified, not inflated for marketing.

connections.title: When the shelves start talking to one another.
connections.body: Biology meets chemistry. Physics meets mathematics. History meets economics. MAUAI is being built to show what each source says, where a connection is explicit, and where inference begins.
connections.note: Knowledge does not stay on the shelf. It joins the conversation.

privacy.title: Yours, on your computer.
privacy.body: Local-first is not a marketing decoration. It is an architectural boundary. The core is designed to run on the user's device without a silent cloud fallback.

points.title: Local by default
points.body: In the planned local flow, conversations and personal-library data stay on the computer.

points.title: Online only by choice
points.body: Future online connectors will be optional, visible, and separate from local answers.

points.title: No mandatory telemetry
points.body: The product is designed without compulsory tracking. Problem reports begin locally and are exported only with user consent.

points.title: Models change. Your library remains.
points.body: AI weights can be replaced. Your documents, metadata, and history are the assets that matter.

companion.title: Your computer is the engine. Your phone is the window.
companion.body: Phone and tablet access is planned as a secure companion: the interface opens in a browser while processing and the library remain on the computer. This is not part of the first core release.

captain.title: Captain Mau does not know everything. He knows where to look.
captain.body: A calm guide through your library. When he finds evidence, he shows it. When he does not, he says so. Sometimes he takes another lap through the shelves — but he does not invent the port.

story.title: It started with a plant in a garden.
story.body: MauAI did not begin as a startup pitch. It began with a simple question: could a small local AI look at a sick plant, search trusted books, and answer without pretending it knew everything? That question grew into a larger idea: a personal library that can speak, explain, and show the source.
story.signature: Built by Mau, with a small crew of AIs and a stubborn belief that good software should remain in the hands of the person who uses it.

earlyAccess.title: Help us build the librarian you would trust.
earlyAccess.body: The first tests will focus on what matters: installation, Library search, citations, 16 GB performance, and clear problem reporting. No polished promises before evidence.
earlyAccess.privacy: Information submitted through the form will be used only for MAUAI early access and product updates. No list sales. No third-party advertising.

faq.a: Not yet. The commercial product is in active development. The website must clearly show its pre-launch status and must not present fake download buttons.
That is not the product idea. MAUAI puts the library first and gives AI the role of librarian: search, explain, and show the source.
The core is designed to work offline after setup and required packs are downloaded. This will be marketed only after installation and soak tests pass.

faq.q: Do my documents go to the cloud?
faq.a: Not in the planned local flow. Online features will be optional and visible. No silent cloud fallback.

faq.q: Will it support Mac and Windows?
faq.a: Both are commercial targets. A simultaneous launch depends on real hardware validation on macOS and Windows.

faq.q: Will it run on 16 GB of RAM?
faq.a: 16 GB is the provisional product target. It is not yet a marketing guarantee; models and workflows are being tested on real hardware.

faq.q: Are the answers guaranteed to be true?
faq.a: No book and no AI offers absolute truth. MAUAI is being built for traceability: it should show which source and passage support an answer.

faq.q: What happens when the documents do not contain the answer?
faq.a: The librarian abstains or offers to search deeper. It does not fill the gap from model memory and present that as evidence.
Pricing is not final. The preferred direction is a perpetual licence for the purchased major version, without a mandatory subscription, subject to real support and distribution costs.

faq.q: Can I use it from my phone?
faq.a: A secure browser companion is planned after the desktop core. The computer remains the engine; the phone becomes the interface.

download.title: Downloads come after proof, not before.
download.body: Signed macOS and Windows builds will appear here after validation. Until then, the website shows the product's real state.

footer.tagline: Knowledge navigates. We get you there.
